sentences.en: We will post the announcement in all the staff lounges.
sentences.zh: 我们在所有员工休息室都贴了通告。

sentences.en: This is why I didn't want to make an announcement.
sentences.zh: 我之所以不想公开宣布这件事是有原因的。

sentences.en: I couldn't understand the announcement that was just made.
sentences.zh: 刚才发布的通告我都没听懂。

senses.zh: 通告，布告，通知；预告 - 宣告，宣布
